notes.title: NEW TRAILER and FINAL UPDATE HERE
notes.content:
[h1]YO! [/h1]
This will be the final update here before moving to the new page here on steam. With the release of the novel 90 days or so away, The demo and early release of the visual novel will be before that. 

Some changes to the idea of extras in the Visual Novel have taken place. I thought about doing tokens or shards as discussed in a previous post, but splitting up the token cost among the numerous scenes is way complicated and frustrating. I solved this issue by deleting the tokens and unlocking scenes as a reward for reading the related chapter. I have also grouped them by chapters so they no longer have their own unlock gallery. 

I have added two modes to the Visual Novel. The 'EASTERN MODE'  and 'WESTERN MODE' will be modes that will show sex and nudity or not. If you played The Surfeit: Episode One and got to clothing store, you should understand this concept. You can switch between them at the beginning of each chapter.

Character models have been updated along with locations and objects. This Visual Novel will have much more motion and animations. Exactly like the book, and unlike other Visual novels, you will be able to choose any chapter in the story (that is available) from the start. You can go forward, back or re-read at will with no save points. Of course, there are save and load functions for those mid-chapter saves or favorite scene bookmarks.

Achievements are still planned for completing each act of the story, completing character's story arcs, or after revealing major plot points (such as a death). 

The Trailer below the trailer that will appear on the new steam store page soon. It shows some of the updated models and animations. There is also a much longer trailer for the book release that also has some animation and further story elements. This trailer is available on the website at wildtirki.com.

Many Thanks to everyone for reading,
W.B. Freeborn
Wild Tirki Fiction

notes.title: New Year. New Details.
notes.content:
[b]All Happened Before[/b]

As previously said, The visual novel was to supplement the core story and explore multiple alternate realities based on choice. It was designed as a 'what if' story with a more profound character background and world-building than the paperback novel.  While this project has been canceled, The Surfeit visual novel will continue, but it will be a copy of the core story and have nothing to do with the alternate realities.

[b]Release Date[/b]
For The Surfeit: Complete, the release is set about April 2024. It will be 13 months after the release of the paperback book and e-book. The Steam Store page will go up this coming summer / autumn with early release available. There will be a price to pay for this product, but that price has not been determined.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39544819/db77ad272d04c6b2d28104292f98c22008faea1a.png[/img]

[b]Doing it solo[/b]
I am doing this alone. My skill set is limited. I do not have a team like some of the other visual novels offered here on Steam. I am entirely willing to work with others that have the skills to enhance this product, but I'm also not afraid to get it done by myself. If you would like to talk about working together on this project, I am open to it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39544819/665d0a0e9b822bf4925a35355b2448c70a96e8b4.png[/img]

[b]Open to idea and suggestions[/b]
The Surfeit: Complete will not have any choices in the story. Each of the small chapters will reward you with a fatsium shard. Collect enough of these to unlock extended sex scenes, character background, different viewpoints and other pieces of story not included in the core narrative. I am taking ideas and suggestions for which scenes and event to include.

I have already received requests to keep the Elyssia and Sati childhood meeting and to actually show the LiPS sexual championship as told of in Arkysa's side of the story. What other things would you like to see? What do you think should not be included?

[b]Ren'py vs. Tyranobuilder[/b]
I'm currently learning how to use Ren'py as that was a huge concern of many. I make [b][u] A LOT [/u][/b] of typos and it is frustrating me. This is why I hate to code and why Tyranobuilder is so attractive to me. It is very likely that this product may be done in tyranobuilder. Even with all the flexibility and convenience that Ren'py has, I can produce the exact same product with less frustration, and a whole lot less lost time, with tyranobuilder. I'm sorry to those if this future choice makes you cringe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39544819/606d449866d8a6cc8168fe08855c910ca886e5f9.png[/img]

[b]Going Forward[/b]

A book trailer has been released to promote the release of the book due out in few months. The images and animations are the same ones that will be used in The Surfeit: Complete. The trailer is hosted on Youtube but is unlisted. I will link it here for you. You can also watch it on the Wild Tirki Fiction website at [url=https://wildtirki.com/]wildtirki.com[/url]
[previewyoutube=m6krhw4miKQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Steam Library Images[/b]
I have been working on some new images for the new steam page.
The first image is a 're-skin' of the book cover.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39544819/68b7679bc00c923033c4086f47b127885ac8db23.jpg[/img]

The second image shows more of the characters, but also shows off my horrible design and photoshop skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39544819/37b90f4307d8bcd21dd29f56610ccae0db58bbbe.jpg[/img]

Which do you like better? 
Discuss here or on the brand new discord channel. (invite found on the above website)


Thanks to everyone who is still communicating with me about The Surfeit. Your continued interest is my reason for being. You are all irreplaceable. I wish everyone an awesome Winter / Holiday season.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39544819/a793d2ee1233df375696fc690491e8a2803059ef.jpg[/img]

Thanks again,
WB Freeborn

notes.title: The Surfeit: Complete
notes.content:
[h1]Good day![/h1]

[b]Due to demand to continue the story[/b], I have decided not to abandon those who have actually read into the story and invested a bit of their time. But, there will be major changes.

[olist]
[*]It will not be episodes. Just one full story.
[*]The alternative time lines will not continue. The story will be a [i]'cut and paste'[/i] of the book.
[*]It will [u]not[/u] have voice acting or music.
[*]It will be paid. The price will be under 10USD and no steam keys will be given. But, for those who have asked for a continue, or voiced dismay, they will be gifted by me. 
[*]It will be a kinetic novel with no choices.
[*]It will use STEAM functionality and features, such as Achievements.
[*]The book is 500 pages for the Epic core story. As you read you will earn tokens "keys" to unlock scenes not in the book, such as expanded sex scenes, viewpoints, perspectives and locations.
[/olist]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39544819/eaefb475302f0f4e83aab84c57db4c7766bc666c.png[/img]

The product will use a [b]new steam ID [/b]and be separate from this one. This version will be kept online as long as Steam allows. Steam will be the only official place to get The Surfeit: Episode 1. While The Surfeit: Complete will be available on other platforms, It will have less content and be considered a ' lite ' version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39544819/ca83ec41b3489abf60188d7354e11b46da0eec1f.png[/img]

The Surfeit: Complete has a release window of [b]2024[/b] after the 2023 release of the paperback and ebook versions. Special rewards will be given to those inside The Surfeit: Complete for purchasing the book or ebook.

[b]In closing[/b], I would like to thank those who have supported The Surfeit in all its forms, whether it was done publicly, privately or silently. I'm proud to have met you through this work.  I applaud those who have played, streamed and openly enjoyed the adult content, despite the stigma society has placed on adult fiction and porn.

To those who have reinforced that stigma, hindered the progress, or hated and harassed those that have partaken in it, I give you a hearty... 

[u][b]Nif you!   [/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39544819/455039d1a6afe23297abc9a3d8d273eed7294a18.png[/img]

notes.title: The End is here.
notes.content:
​Good day everyone!

I am here today to inform you of the removal of all content I have released on this platform as of July 1, 2022.

In July, the surfeit project will have been in development for 6 years.

The novel, which this product is based on, was supposed to be released first. But due to political gatekeeping issues it has not been. I decided to gain some interest in my novel series, by doing a visual novel. As an ex-screenwriter, I felt I could do a visual medium of story telling. I was wrong. I tried to hire others to help me develop the project, but the ones who were interested were harassed in many ways.  Some were  stalked, some lost jobs, while others were fired by their agencies... just for working with me.


What was my crime? Well... It wasn't what I did as much as what I am. I'm a middle-class, middle aged, straight, white, male american who believes in a higher power. My personal beliefs have never gotten in the way of my job.  I wrote for both sides; this was my crime. I was excluded for including everyone;  for writing fiction to whomever paid... and sometimes for free as a favor.

In the surfeit novel, the characters are told of multiple realities. The Hybrid and Visual novels exist to explore those alternate realities. It was like writing a whole other book for each reality, each route the story could take. These exist as a supplement to the unpublished core story.


These projects are going to be taken down as they never found their place, due to my incompetence.  I'm a story teller, gifted with vision. I am not a game designer, 3d artist, sound engineer or any of the other things this project needed. Because of my problem, being who I am, I was forced to work alone. I've tried my best and you can tell these project are trying to be something, but I just don't have the ability to bring out that potential. Even the best writers need a second eye, an editor, but I was unable to get one who would work with me. So, even the writing has a few problems and errors. None of it is good enough.


In closing, after losing my social media accounts and having bank account hacked, I am no longer going forward with anything other than writing.  I have been deeply hurt and those who have worked with me have been hurt as well. They didn't deserve what happened to them for just wanting to do their job.  It was my fault they got hurt and that rips me up inside.  No one should be discriminated against for their personal identity or lifestyle.  No one, or any one associated with the person, should be the victim of hate.


Because of the internet, I know these projects will never die and always be available somewhere, but I no longer want them around.

Thank you to everyone who has downloaded one of these projects. If you enjoyed my writing for whatever reason. I'm not going to quit writing, I'm just going to do it alone for now on. I can bare the hurt alone.

Have a great day everyone and thanks for reading,

W.B. Freeborn

notes.title: UPDATE LIVE!
notes.content:
Yo, Everyone!

Feedback update is now LIVE.

[list]
[*][b]START AGAIN[/b] is now available on start. No more glitch where it would get stuck and never show itself. It is now a permanent part of the select screen. This skips credits, background of planet and the battle of Tern.
[*] [b]UNLOCK[/b] all points of change by clicking on Elyssia's necklace. Also, you will be given a choice to reveal solutions to hidden events which require more then one toggle for use with the rewind menu.
[*][b]SAVE SLOTS[/b] have been increased by three times. Now 15 instead of 5. Please note: Save states retain the variables which were saved and cannot be used with rewind. You have to go back to the beginning of a story and use skip to see changes.
[*] [b]TYPOS![/b] Many typos have been corrected, but not all. My eyes gloss over a lot of them. If you wish to report one, a screenshot will not help. Nothing is copy-paste and each story has it's own text, even though it is the same event.  [i][u]To Report[/u][/i]: Go to the community hub, post in the topic typos, or create your own topic, and put which story and which location. example: Hino the cafe.  This will help me greatly with corrections, as I don't have to look through three different cafe scripts.
[*][b]SEX SCENES![/b] Since the focus is not on sex, as this is not a porn game, sex scenes have not been changed, lengthened or written to be more erotic. Sex and nudity in the Elronde Commonwealth is extremely common place, much like going to eat at a restaurant. As a storyteller, I elected to not spend thousands of words describing how good a piece of meat tastes or feels on the tongue.
[/list]

[u]If you do not see the START AGAIN option at bottom center on the select screen, you have to reinstall.[/u]

Demo for episode 2 will be available in late August. Episode 2 is planned for an OCT/NOV release.

Thank for reading!

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE!
notes.content:
Due to the two pieces of detailed feedback I have received since January , an update to the visual novel is coming within a fortnight. (two weeks)

Here is what is getting worked on...

[olist]
[*][b]START AGAIN[/b]. Start again is broken. It is an option at the bottom of the select screen as seen in the rewind video tutorial on youtube. It should appear after your first playthough and allow you to skip through credits, story, the battle of Tern and planet background. These unskippable scenes were only supposed to be that way for the [u]first playthrough only.[/u] This worked properly in the demo, but got broke somehow. I discovered this major blunder myself. [b]To Fix[/b] this issue, START AGAIN option will be static on the select screen. This will allow you to skip the opening credits, overarching story, battle of Tern and planet background. Skipping over the '[i]encyclopedic exposition[/i]' 

[*][b]CONTROL[/b]. Space bar will be added to right mouse and enter as progress keys.

[*][b]TEXT[/b] Many typos will be corrected. But since my eyes will skim over some of them, some will survive.

[*] [b]STEAM OVERLAY[/b] I don't know how this quite works yet, but I would like to include it in this update.

[*][b]UNLOCKS[/b] On the current live build, if you click on Elyssia's jeweled necklace on the select screen, all points of change will be unlocked. In update, story events that require multiple points to be triggered will now have an option to have the trigger solutions displayed. This will make viewing certain events such as, the foursome in the cafe, Azalea's escape from chains, or Flora's murder much easier to enjoy. (or know the exist)
[/olist]

I hope you look forward to the update.
